prompt.text:
$$y=4x+8$$
$$y=3x+1$$
In the $xy$-plane, the graphs of the given equations intersect at $(x, y)$. What is the value of $x$?

The equation $8 p+8 w=720$ represents the number of purple tiles, $p$, and the number of
white tiles, $w$, a designer needs to cover a 720-square-inch section of a wall. The designer needs
34 purple tiles for the wall. How many white tiles does she need?

$$y=-6.5$$
$$y=x2+8x+a$$
In the given system of equations, $a$ is a positive integer constant. The system has no real
solutions. What is the least possible value of $a$?

In the $xy$-plane, the graph of the equation $( x - 6 ) 2+( y - 10 ) 2=36$ is a
circle. The point $(12, c)$, where $c$ is a constant, lies on this circle. What is the value of $c$?

$$ax2+176x+c$$
In the given expression, $a$ and $c$ are positive constants. If $px+q$ is a factor of the expression, where
$p$ and $q$ are positive constants, what is the greatest possible value of $ac$?

A linear model estimates the population of a city from 1995 to 2019. The model estimates the
population was 56thousand in1995, 215 thousand in 2015, and $x$ thousand in 2019. To the nearest
whole number, what is the value of $x$?

According to a set of standards, pure biodiesel fuel can contain a maximum of $0.001\%$phosphorus
by mass. If a sample of pure biodiesel fuel has a mass of 290 grams, what is the maximum mass,
in grams, of phosphorus the sample can contain to meet these standards?

A proposal for a construction project was included on a city election ballot. A $TV$ news report
stated that 8 times as many people voted in favor of the proposal as people who voted against it.
An internet article reported that 66,500 more people voted in favor of the proposal than voted
against it. Based on these data, how many people voted against the proposal?

The function $f$ is defined by $f ( x )=a x+b$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants. In the $xy$-
plane, the graph of $y=f ( x )$ has an $x$-intercept at $(2, 0)$ and a $y$-intercept at $( 0 , - 15 )$.
What is the value of $b$?

The area of a triangle is equal to $x 2$ square centimeters. The length of the base of the
triangle is $2 x+12$ centimeters, and the height of the triangle is $x - 2$ centimeters. What is
the value of $x$?

$$56x2+(56s+r)x+rs=0$$
In the given equation, $r$ and $s$ are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the equation
is $krs$, where $k$ is a constant. What is the value of $k$?
